assign.outcome:
**The layout browser is live — every layout on the site in one wall, with Approve and Improve on each one.** [/layouts/browse/](/layouts/browse/)

![The three walls at 1920](browse-1920.jpg)

**Three tiers, 99 items, every one pictured.** Global 45 (the 5 approved layouts, the 12 ids of the layout standard, the 18 numbered arrangements, the 10 app shells) · Sections 24 (the sections realm, the 12 paging templates, the 8 screens) · Components 30 (22 `ui`, 8 `ux`). The tier strip at the top jumps between the walls and counts what is approved. Nothing was left unpictured: 12 cards draw a live wireframe from `layouts.json`, 5 reuse the approved-layout jpegs, and 82 were screenshotted at 400 / 1920 / 3440 (246 jpegs, 4.6 MB, largest 40 KB).

**A card opens to the thing at three widths, the way to the real page, and why it is that way** — [example](/layouts/browse/shell-left/). The "why" is not written here: the item's own module `readme.md` watch-out list and its `doc/decisions.md` are fetched and quoted, one click down, so they cannot drift.

**Approve / Improve works end to end.** A press appends one line to [`verdicts.jsonl`](/layouts/verdicts.jsonl) through `rpc:append`, the line comes back off the dev socket, and the verdict, the card's mark and the tier count all update with no reload. Driven headless for real, then the file was truncated back to zero bytes — the owner is the only writer. Append-only: changing your mind is a later verdict, and the history is one click down. Off localhost the buttons are not drawn and the page says why; the verdicts still render.

**Measured at 400 / 1280 / 1920 / 3440**: 1 / 3 / 5 / 8 grid columns, no horizontal overflow, nothing at x:0, no prose past the measure, no broken image, no console error on any of 12 urls. Two real findings fixed: a sticky bar painting `--surface` over a `--wash` page read as a bright empty band, and the item body claiming `wide` gave a one-line `summary` a 1,766px grey bar.

**Docs:** [readme](/layouts/browse/readme.md) · [Inventory](/layouts/browse/doc/inventory/) · [Decisions](/layouts/browse/doc/decisions/). Linked from [/layouts/](/layouts/) itself — a `children:` line alone left it with zero links on the parent, so the parent's `content()` got one line too.

**Left for the owner**, in `doc/decisions.md`: an item is one URL, so `/imagine/sections/` is four items even though its page draws a dozen bands (a band with no url has nothing to link to or screenshot); whether an approval should mark anything outside this page; and what an Improve note should trigger next.
